maximum_depth_rule: The reviewed current-plan source contains one observation statement about the 2011-2021 trend in per-capita prefectural income. It does not provide a reviewed future target or a separately linked annual actual record.
history_boundary: Current-plan observation indicators, prior-plan KPI series, and policy-inspection self-evaluations remain separate layers. No old series or self-evaluation is inherited automatically.
non_goals: Do not parse several numeric tokens into an inferred single series.
Do not treat the reviewed observation statement as a future target.
Do not treat the plan text as a separately reviewed annual actual.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
